frases: Oh my… I haven't been up here in ages.
It's so dark in here.
Dad left his keys somewhere around here…
I wonder where they are.
My piggy bank! My old piggy bank!
I remember saving up for so long. To become a great artist.
Ooh! How much money is in it?…
Nothing, there's nothing.
What did I spend it on?
Grandma's music box. They said she was a great dancer, but she had to give it up…
“For the family, you learn to give in,” she used to tell my mother, and my mother told me. And I learned fast.

pieza_dibujo: Girls don't draw monsters, right, Mom? Princesses, kittens, the family, ballerinas… but no monsters.

frases: Kitty! Now I know you're an otter…
I always hid you from my brother, until one day he cried so much that I gave you to him to make him happy.

pieza_mp3.frases: Oh wow! I always used to share my MP3…

frases: And there isn't a single song on it I like… Now that I think about it…
I dressed like them, watched those silly shows, listened to this rubbish to fit in… to be part of the group.
I love photography! I took it on our trips, to birthdays, to the village festivals…
Huh, I'm not in any of them…
Well, here I am, though my head's cut off and it's a bit blurry.
This is what I wanted to study…
I saved so much, I never touched the piggy bank money for any silly whim…
But Dad's shop needed a van…
Now I remember why the piggy bank is empty…
Ah! Here they are! Dad would lose his head if it weren't screwed on.
Who'd have thought I'd be the one opening the shop every morning. And I swore I never would.
I bought it with my first paycheck. It wasn't much, since almost all of it went into the family pot, but it was enough…
I had the perfect plan: paint every Sunday…
Then the rent went up, and guess who works on Sundays.
And here I am, the one who always says yes to whatever she's asked…
the one who avoids conflict… the one who puts everyone else first…
For the family, you give in… Goodbye, kitty… Hello, Dad's shop…
And me…? When is it my turn?…
All this time I've been living a life that wasn't the one I wanted.
I didn't think for myself… I didn't decide for myself…
I think it's time to change that.
No one ever taught me, but it's never too late to learn.
No!
I won't do it.
Ah… It's not easy to say, but…
Ah… It feels so good to say it out loud.
And as a first act of love…
This coin is…
